# ai-skills-hub — llms.txt

> Machine-readable catalog for agents. Spec: https://agentskills.io/specification
> Italian Work Skills Hub: English agent skills for Italian work.
> Only the README.md is in Italian.

## Skills (MIT, English)

- hello-agent: skills/hello-agent/SKILL.md — Smoke test for skill visibility.
- skill-creator-it: skills/skill-creator-it/SKILL.md — Create new English skills.
- invoice-it: skills/invoice-it/SKILL.md — Italian invoices with VAT.
- email-formale-it: skills/email-formale-it/SKILL.md — Formal Italian business email.
- xlsx-budget-it: skills/xlsx-budget-it/SKILL.md — Monthly Excel budgets.
- translate-it-en: skills/translate-it-en/SKILL.md — IT-EN translation, code intact.
- press-release-it: skills/press-release-it/SKILL.md — Press releases.
- doc-polish-it: skills/doc-polish-it/SKILL.md — Improve README/docs.
- case-study: skills/case-study/SKILL.md — Case studies with real numbers.

Details in catalog/skills.json. Archived generic skills in archive/ (not installed).

## Install

- `python scripts/install.py --all`
- `python scripts/install.py --skill <name> --agent claude|codex|grok|cursor|copilot|copilot-cli|gemini|opencode|windsurf`
- `python scripts/validate.py`
- Layout `skills/*/SKILL.md` also works with `gh skill install`.

## Vendors (reference only)

- anthropics/skills: https://github.com/anthropics/skills
- openai codex skills: https://developers.openai.com/codex/skills
- grok skills: https://docs.x.ai/build/features/skills-plugins-marketplaces.md
